Viduq2 models upgraded new abilities: Reference to image, Text to image and image editing. - The invocation methods and examples of the model’s new abilities can be found in the API references. - You can check the cost on the pricing page November 13, 2025 New Audio&Video Direct Output Capability - Audio&video direct output is now available for Vidu Reference to Video and Image to Video. - You can configure subjects and their spoken lines using the subjects and audio parameters. - For details, please refer to the API documentations.New Digital Human Capability - Upload a digital human image along with text/voice input to generate a talking-avatar video. - This capability supports selecting a custom voice. - For more information, please see the API documentation.Vidu Q2 Duration Upgrade -
